name: Ai Interpolator Auphonic
description: Submodule of Auphonic: an AI Interpolator field rule ('Auphonic Normalize Audio') that sends a file field's audio to Auphonic for normalization and stores the processed result back on a file field.
project_description: Submodule of the Auphonic project. Provides a single AI Interpolator field rule plugin, 'Auphonic Normalize Audio' (id ai_interpolator_auphonic_normalize_audio), that targets file fields: it takes the audio file(s) referenced by a configured base file field, starts an Auphonic production for each via the auphonic.api client, polls until processing finishes, downloads the processed output, and saves it as a permanent managed file on the target file field. Depends on ai_interpolator and auphonic. Note the submodule's info.yml declares core_version_requirement ^9.2 || ^10 (no ^11) even though the parent module supports ^10 || ^11.
